rows.note: This is the all-purpose spoken construction for excluding A from what was just mentioned.

example.traditional: 我咩都食，除咗芫荽之外。
example.jyutping: ngo5 me1 dou1 sik6 ceoi4 zo2 jyun4 seoi1 zi1 ngoi6

rows.note: Use this shorter form when the excluded item is clear from the sentence and a following 之外 is unnecessary.

example.english: I work every day except Sunday.
example.traditional: 我日日都返工，除咗星期日。
example.jyutping: ngo5 jat6 jat6 dou1 faan1 gung1 ceoi4 zo2 sing1 kei4 jat6

rows.note: This is the all-purpose casual choice for adding an except-that qualification to what was just said.

example.english: This restaurant is quite good, except it’s a bit expensive.
example.traditional: 呢間餐廳幾好食，只係價錢貴咗啲。
example.jyutping: ni1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 gei2 hou2 sik6 zi2 hai6 gaa3 cin2 gwai3 zo2 di1

rows.note: Use this when the exception is presented more broadly as a conversational contrast or qualification.

example.english: I wanted to go, except I’m really too tired today.
example.traditional: 我本身想去，不過今日真係太攰。
example.jyutping: ngo5 bun2 san1 soeng2 heoi3 bat1 gwo3 gam1 jat6 zan1 hai6 taai3 gui6
